notes.note: Traced shutdown and constructor-failure title observer retirement, the stopped check before synchronous SQLite publication, and the unchanged best-effort provider call. Runtime evidence used real EventBus, EventStore and home maintenance with a held synthetic result. Baseline attempted a write after shutdown, and the fixed run also refused a new title event after shutdown.

Rechecked the cited runtime interfaces affected by the additional title teardown delta. The runtime unsubscribes the internal committed-turn title observer at shutdown and suppresses publication of a late title result. Provider/model composition, title-model opt-in, tenant refusal, task/store order and the documented API contracts retain their existing behavior. The regression uses a synthetic model and supplies no provider cancellation or platform qualification.
